title: A read covers the live seqs applied before it: an answer below them does not count them again
why: The client keeps the seqs it applied above the delivered position and applies them again on an answer below them. A read here of those seqs (a persisted read, a read change's refSeq) makes them read, so they must not come back as unread when an answer still behind them arrives (Tenny, #14993 review).
